artifacts.summary: 6-phase plan (5 dependency waves, ~6.5h) for lint-hook-registration-paths.sh implementing four checks, a both-polarity mktemp fixture suite, and verify-deploy gate 21.

memory_candidates.content: Adding a new numbered gate to agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/verify-deploy.sh is never a single-file change: verify-deploy.sh hardcodes the valid --only-gate range (1-20 as of gate 20) at four sites (two header-comment mentions, the non-numeric error string, and the -lt 1/-gt N bound check), and scripts/tests/test-verify-deploy-gate-selection.sh independently hardcodes the count at three assertion sites (case (b) 'seq 1 N', case (d) 'seq 1 N', and the literal N+1 in its invalid_cases list, which becomes a VALID id the moment the gate is added). A gate-adding change that edits only verify-deploy.sh turns a currently-green test red three ways. Audit both files together, and widen the file_scope by that exact test file rather than by a scripts/tests/ directory entry (which collides against most of the open backlog at admission time).
